findings.F-6-1: The empty-editor placeholder names tune number, title, meter, note length, and key. Missing-field errors use the same plain terms.
findings.F-6-2: After the initial page load, a score edit and both accepted and rejected ABC-file selections created no requests.
findings.F-6-3: A 1,000,000-byte ABC file rendered as valid; a 1,000,001-byte file was rejected with its recovery message.
findings.F-6-4: After localStorage.clear(), a reload showed an empty editor and neither real nor demo score key.
